regions.finding: The title and abstract state the new NaI-catalyzed transformation; the introduction discusses prior literature and broad motivation. Prior-work examples were classified as context and were not entered as experiments from this paper.

regions.region: right-column initial trial and Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: The prose identifies the initial 1a/2 batch as Table 1 entry 1 (75% 3a), reports no reaction without NaI for entry 4, and states that catalytic NaI and omission of Na2CO3 are viable. These prose facts were reconciled with, rather than duplicated from, the Table 1 rows on page 2.

regions.region: right-column substrate-scope discussion and unsuccessful cases
regions.finding: The prose summarizes Table 2 entries 1–9 and separately reports a t-Bu substrate with no reaction/recovery, an inseparable group of Ph or n-C4H9 acyl-substituted substrates with no expected product, and an unprotected-alcohol substrate giving a complicated reaction. Missing row identities and conditions were preserved as unresolved rather than inferred.
The proposed iodide ring opening, addition to reagent 2, and intramolecular substitution through 4a and 5a were classified as a mechanism, not as isolated reaction batches.

unresolved: The prose-only unsuccessful cases omit exact quantities, durations, workups, and yields; the grouped acyl-substrate sentence cannot be split into a defensible number of experiments.
The paper points to online Supplementary data, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: upper half Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1–15, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: All 15 optimization rows were extracted independently. Shared 1.0 equiv reagent 2 and 0.2 equiv NaI were applied per row, with footnote overrides for 1.0 equiv NaI, 1.2 equiv reagent 2, absence of NaI, complicated reactions, and 88%/69% starting-material recovery. Isolated product yield and recovery remain separate outcomes.
Figure 1 is an ORTEP representation of product 3a and supports the existing Table 1 entry 1 product assignment; it is not a separate synthetic experiment.

regions.region: lower-left Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1–9, and isolated-yield footnote
regions.finding: All nine substrate-scope rows were extracted independently under the shared THF/reflux, NaI 0.2 equiv, and reagent-2 1.0 equiv conditions. Each isolated yield is linked to its row-specific product label 3b–3j.
Scheme 1 depicts proposed intermediates 4a and 5a and was retained as one plausible-mechanism record, not three experimental reactions.

regions.region: lower-right acknowledgments and Supplementary data notice
regions.finding: The acknowledgments say Table 2 entries 3 and 9 were reproduced. The page states that Supplementary data are available online, but this is not an explicit supplied-file association and no SI evidence was imported.

unresolved: The main-text tables omit reaction scale, atmosphere, detailed operations, workup, and purification.
Table 2 substrate/product SMILES were not generated from R-group drawings without independent structure review.
Supplementary data were not supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.finding: This region contains cited prior literature only. It was classified as reference context and produced no experiments for the present paper.
Note 12 reports crystallographic parameters and CCDC 712641 for compound 3a. This characterization evidence was linked to Table 1 entry 1 and was not treated as a new reaction experiment.

unresolved: No additional reaction batches are reported on this page.
Crystallographic characterization does not verify the machine-generated SMILES encoding.
